messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "oral granules should be taken 30 minutes before a meal"
set: ["oral granules should be taken 30 minutes before a meal", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC", "taken 30 minutes before the start of single-day HEC", "should be taken with food, with the evening meal", "oral granules should be mixed with applesauce or apple juice when taken by mouth", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "taken at least 30 minutes before first food beverage or other oral medications of the day", "should not be taken after about 30 weeks of pregnancy", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "15 to 30 minutes", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "caregiver should be trained before first dose", "first dose given 30 minutes before start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "first dose administered 30 minutes before the start of chemotherapy", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
